name: HUNTRESS 🕷️ [NIGHTMARE]
desc:
Something with eight legs lives in this building. The doors are sealed, and it already knows you're inside.


Explore two dark floors in this first-person horror escape, alone or with up to 3 friends. Find the dynamite, hide in the vents when the giant spider hunts, and blow the gate to survive!

llm.loop: explore dark floors -> find dynamite while a giant spider hunts -> hide in vents -> blow the gate to escape
llm.objectives: find the dynamite and escape the building alive
llm.instructions: explore two floors, find dynamite, hide in vents when the spider hunts, blow the gate; solo or with up to 3 friends
llm.thumbnails: giant spider crawling through dark corridors and vents
llm.complexity_notes: custom animated spider monster with AI, atmospheric lighting, two-floor map
